final_message:
The yen receipt test passes now, and the full suite is green (18/18).

**Cause:** `formatMoney` in `src/utils/money.js` divided every amount by 100. That is right for GBP, USD and EUR, but yen has no minor unit, so ¥500 came out as "¥5.00".

**Fix:** I added a small `DECIMALS` table with `JPY: 0`. Every other currency still defaults to 2 digits, so pounds, dollars and euros are unchanged. The formatter divides by `10 ** digits` and formats with that many decimals.

This also fixes yen in invoice lines and cart totals, since they use the same helper. Those paths have no yen test, so I checked them by reading the code only.

I only added JPY. Other zero-decimal currencies such as KRW would still render with two decimals, so they will need the same entry if you use them. I didn't change anything else.
